title: loom design tokens
description: Loom's equivalent of tailwind.config: custom colors, spacing, breakpoint thresholds and themes. Everything merges into the built-in token set rather than replacing it. Referenced from loom.json via its `design` key, and loadable on its own with loom::loadConfig().

colors.description: Nested hue objects become `hue-shade` keys (brand-500); flat entries keep their name. Merged into the built-in palette.

space.description: Extra spacing steps in pixels, usable everywhere {n} is (p-18, w-18, gap-18).

breakpoints.description: Moves the sm/md/lg/xl thresholds. The four tiers are structural; new tier names are rejected.

themes.description: Semantic-token overrides. Merging into light/dark adjusts the built-ins in place; any other name defines a new theme.

extends.description: Theme to copy from before applying these overrides. Any already-known theme.

dark.description: Feeds Loom.dark and the dark: variant. Inherited from the base theme otherwise.

additionalProperties.description: A palette key (config-defined included) or a color literal.

defaultTheme.description: Theme to switch to after loading.

iconRoot.description: Directory a relative Loom.icon() source resolves against, relative to this file.
